title: Research for a planned sprint lands under its item
goal: A research task or story of a planned (not started) sprint can land its kb content commits with KB-Work and be proven by backlog.py done without starting the sprint, as backlog.md states; check-trailers accepts such a commit only when it changes kb content and the item files, never _tools/, .claude/ or CI; ST-rjxacpdh, TK-nytjligk and the ST-mmmn42ks tasks, whose research landed without KB-Work, are closed or dropped with the commit named
notes: Research landed ahead of planned sprints without KB-Work, because check-trailers refuses work for items outside a started sprint: 7d1175f7 (meets ST-rjxacpdh's goal), b6baa207 (TK-nytjligk), d0db1b38 (the ST-mmmn42ks tasks). Changing check-trailers is a rule change: the runbook and git.md change with it.
